verdict.rationale: Mollie documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks: a URL Mollie calls with the ID of the updated object. Its next-gen Webhooks API lets you permanently subscribe to specific event types and choose full-snapshot or simple payloads. It also documents HMAC signature verification via X-Mollie-Signature, a Webhook Events API for retroactively inspecting past deliveries, and Webhooks/Webhook Events tools exposed through the MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery reliability.
